title: VanillaBased
description: VanillaBased aims to spice up your world without changing the feel of the original textures.
body:
VanillaBased is an **in progress** resource pack that aims to add detail to your minecraft textures or improve old or ugly textures. While VanillaBased does completely change certain textures, my main goal is to add small details to blocks and have a vanilla friendly resource pack. I am the only person working on this pack so progress may be slow or there will be long delays before an update. This resource pack was made and tested for minecraft java 1.21 however it may work in previous versions.

 

As of now (V2) features include:

 Revamped acacia doors and trapdoors
Additional details to acacia blocks
 Details added to activator rail and anvil
